id: title:christiaan-ph:make evaluation and tagger status pills clickable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds clickable navigation to AI evaluation status indicators, allowing users to resolve configuration issues without remaining on a generic error state.
review.reason: Adds clickable behavior and navigation to error and warning status indicators for AI evaluations and taggers, allowing users to navigate to relevant settings or detail pages. This is a localized UI improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the observed addition of onClick handlers and navigation; no tests or backend changes are visible. The benefit is inferred from the code change, not demonstrated by test results or release notes. No adoption or incident avoidance is established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected.

observations.behavior: Adds clickable behavior and navigation to error and warning status indicators.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a user viewing an AI evaluation error to click the status tag and navigate to the relevant evaluation detail or settings page, rather than remaining on a generic error state.

observations.behavior: Adds clickable behavior and navigation to warning status indicators.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a user viewing an AI evaluation key issue warning to click the status tag and navigate to the settings page to resolve the API key configuration.
